summary: כַּשְׂדִּי names a member of the Chaldean people. Genesis uses the plural in the place designation “Ur of the Chaldeans.”

senses.definition: A person belonging to the Chaldean nation. The plural can designate the people collectively.

evidence.note: The verse identifies הַכַּשְׂדִּים as הַגּוֹי, “the nation.”
אוּר כַּשְׂדִּים identifies Ur by the people associated with it.
Terah’s household departs מֵאוּר כַּשְׂדִּים, “from Ur of the Chaldeans.”
Yahweh tells Abram that he brought him מֵאוּר כַּשְׂדִּים, “from Ur of the Chaldeans.”

senses.gloss: a member of the Chaldean people
